research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sunrun is researching and developing surface mount assemblies for solar panel systems, as described in 'Surface mount assemblies for a solar panel system,' which details a base and enclosure for mounting panels. The company is also working on enclosure assemblies with housings for electrical installations in solar power systems, single-piece hinged clamps for mounting solar modules, cable holder assemblies for managing wiring, and methods for installing non-conventional fasteners. These efforts focus on solar panel installation and system integration.

overview_description.description:
Sunrun is a United States-based provider of residential solar electricity and solar power services for homeowners. It invented a model known as solar service allowing homeowners to pay for the power, not the panels. It owns, maintains, and monitors the system while homeowners pay for the electricity it produces at a low, locked-in rate, saving them money over time.

Sunrun operates in twelve states that include Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Massachusetts, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Nevada, Pennsylvania, Oregon, and Connecticut. Each business day it puts 2 million U.S. dollars’ worth of solar onto people’s roofs and facilitates one solar installation every 10 minutes. The company’s network of over 30 solar installers employs more than 3,000 people.


Sunrun was founded in 2007 by Edward Fenster, Lynn Jurich, and Nat Kreamer. It is headquartered in San Francisco, C.A.

product.description: Purchase options for homeowners who want to own a Sunrun-installed solar system, with available financing and applicable incentives handled as part of the sales process.

product.description: A battery installation service for eligible existing Sunrun customers who want to add storage to an installed solar system.
